resources.string: This deletes all notes from your device permanently. This cannot be undone.
Set up a fingerprint or face unlock in Android Settings to enable this.
Ask for your fingerprint or face every time the app opens. Notes stay private even when your phone is unlocked.
Permanently delete every note stored on this device.
Both models run entirely on your device — no network, ever. Import each file you downloaded; we copy it into private storage.
Gemma 4 E2B, ~1.5 GB, a .litertlm file. Without it, notes are saved as plain text. Download it from Google AI (ai.google.dev/gemma).
A whisper.cpp ggml-*.bin model (e.g. ggml-small-q5_1.bin, ~180 MB). Without it, dictation can\'t be transcribed. Download from huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp.

Notari does not request the INTERNET permission and makes zero network calls. Audio is held only in RAM during a recording and is overwritten the moment transcription completes — no audio file ever touches disk.
Verify with adb: adb shell dumpsys package com.voicenotemd | grep \"permission.INTERNET\" returns nothing.
• RECORD_AUDIO — needed to capture your voice. We never write the buffer to a file.
By default, dictation uses your phone\'s system language. Android\'s speech recognizer doesn\'t detect the spoken language on its own, so pin a language here if you dictate in a different one.
